general_evidence: Documented material scope, complete human experience review and study/composition provenance; no CLP/GHS inference.

rule_register.logic: substance or whole_mixture_tested -> primary data; untested_mixture -> §2.2.8.1.6 hierarchy
exceptions: water reactive, corrosive gas/vapour Class 8 scope may require separate evaluation

rule_register.logic: existing human/animal data first; human-experience conflict or unsupported human PG -> indeterminate; expert-certified human PG may become calculated candidate
exceptions: documented absence of human evidence is not a negative skin finding
uncertain study timing or observed effect -> indeterminate

logic.if: test corrosive, validly excludes PGI, cannot distinguish II/III
test corrosive, cannot distinguish any PG, no other tests indicate different PG

exceptions: valid method and supporting report required

inputs: UN MTC Test C.1 evidence and protocol
logic: rate_mm_year > 6.25 on either permitted steel or aluminium -> candidate PG III
uniform mass loss (%) > [13.5,26.5,39.2,51.5] for days [7,14,21,28] -> candidate PG III
local intrusion (micrometres) > [120,240,360,480] on same durations -> candidate PG III
one qualifying metal test proves metal pathway; both valid non-qualifying results needed for negative
test_requirements: at least 3 specimen sets per metal
supported 7/14/21/28-day results and verified exposure hours
exceptions: solid must be capable of becoming liquid in carriage before metal pathway; integration gate outstanding
no average corrosion-only negative if localised corrosion unassessed

logic: dilution of tested source with non-corrosive diluent, unchanged PG and no enhanced corrosion
equivalent same-product batch under same manufacturer's control with no important variation
concentration of tested PG I mixture -> PG I
interpolation of same corrosion-PG tested A/B with intermediate Class 8 concentrations
substantially similar A+B/C+B with matching B, matching A/C contents and equivalent effects
exceptions: bridging flags must be cross-checked against experiments

logic.if: sum_PGI_pct >= 1 OR sum_PGI_pct+sum_PGII_pct >= 5, and prior PGI branch not met
all branches negative and synergy excluded

exceptions: consider all Class 8 ingredients >=1%, and lower ingredients if relevant
without absence of synergistic effects, PG II/III calculation blocked
when specific limits exist, block rather than apply GCL

inputs: verified entry-specific concentration limits in Table A or special provisions
rule_register.logic: specific limits replace generic limits in weighted summation; cases must be resolved by Agent 1 and independently reviewed before code enables
exceptions: NO unsupported substitution of generic threshold when SCL present

rule_register.logic: forward to Lead/Agent 1; never set dgl_packing_group or final transport status
exceptions: UN 1798 and specified chemically unstable acids/prohibited carriage

inputs: other hazard class findings and constituent risk evidence
rule_register.logic: return candidate to Agent 2; no final 6.1/3/4.3/5.1 precedence or subsidiary risk assignment
exceptions: no Class 8 PG treated as final DGL PG

unsupported_cases: source data with unknown study or metal C1 protocol
named entries and Table A PG
chemical instability / not accepted for carriage
